name: Mortgage Required Income Calculator
meta_title: Mortgage Income Calculator: Salary Needed to Buy a Home
meta_description: Find the gross income you need to qualify for a mortgage on a given home price, using front-end and back-end debt-to-income limits.
subtitle: Work out the gross income a lender would want to see for a home at a given price. It adds up the full monthly housing payment and checks it against front-end and back-end debt-to-income limits.
